reasons.plausibility: The hypothesis incorrectly assumes Mn-free CrCoNi has lower stacking fault energy than CrMnFeCoNi, whereas experiments consistently show the opposite trend, undermining the proposed mechanism.
reasons.testability: The proposed in situ TEM tensile test with quantitative measurement of hcp onset strain and work hardening provides a clear, feasible path to falsify the hypothesis.
reasons.usefulness: Despite the flawed SFE assumption, the hypothesis addresses a key mechanistic question and proposes a well-defined comparative experiment that would advance understanding of deformation in these alloys.
